description: Import a photo or a folder recursively. A JPEG with a non-DNG raw file of exactly the same name (only the extension's case may differ) stays the raw's sidecar: folders leave it out and report skipped_sidecar_jpegs; importing that JPEG alone fails and names the raw. Other JPEGs import as their own photos. Files already in the catalog are left unchanged and counted in already_in_catalog. A file whose folder, or whose name within its folder, differs only in case from one in the catalog fails, because Lightroom matches both case-insensitively; on a case-insensitive volume such a name is the same file and counts in already_in_catalog. Lightroom and Photos library packages are skipped. Returns imported, already_in_catalog, added_to_collection, skipped_by_extension, skipped_sidecar_jpegs and skipped_package_files; a file that fails is failed {path, reason} when nothing was written for it (a busy catalog included) and unknown when something was, naming it (a copy or folder copy_to made, or the photo addPhoto may have added); a single-file source raises instead, with the same class; files not reached before the time budget are remaining; photos not added to the collection make the result partial. A failed file leaves the catalog and disk unchanged.

collection_name.description: Collection path from list_collections, or a bare name. A listed path always picks that collection; a bare name of a nested collection must be unique. Imported and already cataloged photos are added to it; an unknown or smart collection fails before importing (optional).

copy_to.description: Absolute path of a folder to copy files and sidecars into, keeping subfolders, and import the copies; ~/ is expanded; only the platform's separator between names (/ on macOS, \ on Windows); no ., .. or empty names (optional)

separate_jpegs.description: Also add a JPEG that would stay a raw file's sidecar as its own photo (default false)

source_path.description: Absolute path of the photo or folder to import; ~/ is expanded; only the platform's separator between names (/ on macOS, \ on Windows); no ., .. or empty names. Folder imports accept camera raw (CR3, RAF, ORF, RW2, NEF, ARW, DNG and other Camera Raw formats), JPEG, HEIC/HEIF, AVIF, JPEG XL, TIFF, PNG and PSD/PSB; other files are skipped by extension.
